reference: System GNU gzip zcat (requiring both zcat and gzip); small gzip byte streams were generated independently with Python's standard-library gzip encoder using mtime=0. Each parity case compares candidate behavior against GNU zcat. Diagnostic text is intentionally allowed to vary; statuses, stdout bytes, and fixture trees are compared.
coverage: Named gzip input and redirected stdin.
The '-' stdin operand between named files, preserving operand order.
Concatenated gzip members in one input.
Binary output including NUL and high-bit bytes.
Empty stdin versus an empty named file.
Non-gzip input, missing-file continuation, truncated input, and CRC failure.
Bash help/type metadata contract (metadata only; not operation coverage).
Repeated stdin operands, including EOF and continuation to named files.
Valid empty gzip members and concatenated members ending in an integrity error.
CRC and length failures with retained output, stdin CRC failure, and a bounded output-buffer crossing.
Reject a valid zlib wrapper under the gzip-only contract.
Small stored gzip members exercise both split and exact input-buffer boundaries.
exclusions: GNU gzip option compatibility beyond the documented zcat [FILE...] interface is not asserted.
Standard input is deterministic file redirection or the runner's empty stdin; interactive and streaming producer timing are outside this suite.
Large streams, gzip optional metadata, environmental I/O failures, trailing non-member data and producer timing are not qualified by these bounded fixtures.

cases.purpose: Decode a small gzip file supplied by name and preserve its text bytes exactly.
Decode a gzip stream from redirected stdin when no file operands are given.
Process named files before and after the special '-' stdin operand, concatenating all decoded bytes in operand order.
cases.script:
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x4b\xcc\x29\xc8\x48\xe4\x4a\x4a\x2d\x49\xe4\x02\x00\x6e\x50\x30\x6e\x0b\x00\x00\x00' > before.gz
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\xb3\x29\x2e\x49\xc9\xcc\xb3\xe3\x02\x00\x77\x61\xb6\x33\x08\x00\x00\x00' > stdin.gz
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\xcb\xcf\x4d\x4d\x4f\x04\x00\x3a\x9d\x19\x4a\x05\x00\x00\x00' > after.gz
zcat before.gz - after.gz < stdin.gz

cases.purpose: Decode two adjacent gzip members in one file; gzip specifies concatenated members as a single concatenated output stream.
cases.script:
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\xcb\x4d\xcd\x4d\x4a\x2d\xd2\xcd\xcf\x4b\xe5\x02\x00\x6c\x37\x8d\x87\x0b\x00\x00\x00' > members.gz
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\xcb\x4d\xcd\x4d\x4a\x2d\xd2\x2d\x29\xcf\xe7\x02\x00\x87\x97\x8d\xe9\x0b\x00\x00\x00' >> members.gz
zcat members.gz

cases.purpose: Preserve NUL, control, high-bit, and final newline bytes in decompressed output.
An empty stdin stream with no operands produces no bytes, reports an error, and exits 1, as independently observed with GNU gzip zcat.
An empty named file is an invalid gzip stream and must fail, just as empty stdin does.
Reject a non-gzip named file with a failing status and a diagnostic.
Report a missing operand but continue processing later valid operands; compare both the status and recovered output.
Reject a gzip stream missing its trailer while preserving any decompressed prefix emitted before the integrity error.
Preserve the decoded payload emitted before a corrupted CRC trailer is diagnosed, then exit 1, as GNU gzip zcat does.
Read stdin for every dash operand: the second read at EOF fails and stops before a later named file, as independently observed with GNU gzip.
cases.script:
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x4b\x2b\xca\xcf\x55\x28\x2e\x49\xc9\xcc\xe3\x02\x00\x1d\x7c\xde\x4f\x0b\x00\x00\x00' > stdin.gz
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x4b\x4c\x2b\x49\x2d\x52\x48\x2d\x2a\xca\x2f\xe2\x02\x00\x2d\xcf\x97\x1c\x0c\x00\x00\x00' > last.gz
zcat - - last.gz < stdin.gz

cases.purpose: An empty dash operand fails after the first file and stops before the last file, preserving output already decoded.
cases.script:
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x4b\x2b\xca\xcf\x55\x28\x2e\x49\xc9\xcc\xe3\x02\x00\x1d\x7c\xde\x4f\x0b\x00\x00\x00' > first.gz
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x4b\x4c\x2b\x49\x2d\x52\x48\x2d\x2a\xca\x2f\xe2\x02\x00\x2d\xcf\x97\x1c\x0c\x00\x00\x00' > last.gz
: > empty
zcat first.gz - last.gz < empty

cases.purpose: A valid empty gzip member is distinct from empty input, and empty members must not stop concatenated decoding.
cases.script:
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x03\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00' > empty.gz
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x03\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x4b\x2b\xca\xcf\x55\x28\x2e\x49\xc9\xcc\xe3\x02\x00\x1d\x7c\xde\x4f\x0b\x00\x00\x00\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x03\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00' > members.gz
zcat empty.gz members.gz

cases.purpose: Preserve decoded bytes from a CRC failure on redirected stdin and return an error.
Preserve the first file and the CRC-failing member output, then stop before later named operands, as GNU gzip does.
cases.script:
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x4b\x2b\xca\xcf\x55\x28\x2e\x49\xc9\xcc\xe3\x02\x00\x1d\x7c\xde\x4f\x0b\x00\x00\x00' > first.gz
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x73\x0e\x72\x56\x28\x48\xac\xcc\xc9\x4f\x4c\xe1\x02\x00\xf0\xe8\xec\xd1\x0c\x00\x00\x00' > bad.gz
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x4b\x4c\x2b\x49\x2d\x52\x48\x2d\x2a\xca\x2f\xe2\x02\x00\x2d\xcf\x97\x1c\x0c\x00\x00\x00' > last.gz

cases.purpose: Emit the valid first member and the decoded payload of a second member with a bad CRC; stop at that error before the third member.
Preserve decoded bytes before diagnosing an incorrect gzip uncompressed-length trailer.
A bounded eight-byte gzip header fails with unexpected EOF and stops before a later valid file.
cases.script:
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00' > short.gz
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x4b\x4c\x2b\x49\x2d\x52\x48\x2d\x2a\xca\x2f\xe2\x02\x00\x2d\xcf\x97\x1c\x0c\x00\x00\x00' > last.gz
zcat short.gz last.gz

cases.purpose: A bounded 9450-byte text payload crosses the decoder output buffer; preserve its entire output on CRC failure.
The documented gzip-only interface rejects a valid zlib-wrapped deflate stream.
Reject plain input and report a missing file, continuing to decode the following valid operand.
cases.script:
printf 'ordinary text\n' > plain.txt
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x4b\x4c\x2b\x49\x2d\x52\x48\x2d\x2a\xca\x2f\xe2\x02\x00\x2d\xcf\x97\x1c\x0c\x00\x00\x00' > last.gz
zcat plain.txt absent.gz last.gz

cases.purpose: An empty named input fails with unexpected EOF and prevents decoding a later named operand.
cases.script:
: > empty.gz
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x4b\x4c\x2b\x49\x2d\x52\x48\x2d\x2a\xca\x2f\xe2\x02\x00\x2d\xcf\x97\x1c\x0c\x00\x00\x00' > last.gz
zcat empty.gz last.gz

cases.purpose: Non-gzip stdin is fatal to this invocation: diagnose it and stop before the later named operand, as observed independently with GNU gzip.
cases.script:
printf 'ordinary text\n' > plain.txt
printf '%b' '\x1f\x8b\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\xff\x4b\x4c\x2b\x49\x2d\x52\x48\x2d\x2a\xca\x2f\xe2\x02\x00\x2d\xcf\x97\x1c\x0c\x00\x00\x00' > last.gz
zcat - last.gz < plain.txt

cases.purpose: Ordinary stored gzip members place the next member magic across an 8192-byte read boundary or exactly at that boundary; decode all bytes in order.
Verify Bash exposes zcat as a builtin and the help builtin can resolve its documented interface without running decompression.
